COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.735 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Naman Kamboj, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Addl. 
C.S.C. with Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, learned 
Brief Holder for the State. 
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. It is the case of the petitioner that 
petitioner was engaged through PRD with 
respondent no.4-School as a Watchman 
(Chaukidar). Subsequently services of the 
petitioner was disengaged and on his place 
respondent no.5 was sent by PRD, who started 
working.
5. Issue notice to respondent nos.4 & 5 
returnable at an early date. 
6. Steps to be taken within a week.
7. Learned State counsel prays for and is 
granted six weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
8. Two weeks’ time thereafter is granted to 
the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.
9. List this petition on 07.08.2024. 
10. In the meantime, private respondents 
may file their counter affidavit(s). 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
